entries.note: Event heading on the tracker; the help centre calls it the Pickup scan, the time the parcel was collected.
The help centre's Status scan: a stage of the journey such as a depot scan.
Event heading on the tracker; the help centre's On Board scan, onto the delivery driver's vehicle.
Event heading on the tracker followed by 'Delivered in area …'.
For a rural delivery the help centre says this means the parcel was handed to the rural partner, with two to three more days to delivery.
Event status the current tracker page's script looks for to draw its first milestone.
Event status the current tracker page's script uses for the delivered milestone.
